card.name: Last digit of Poison Help phone number
card.fires_on: The final digit "2" of the Poison Help line number 1-800-222-1222 in overdose management text. It fires right before the closing parenthesis.

modes.label: Poison Help number ending
modes.description: The last "2" of 1-800-222-1222 in a sentence advising contact with poison control or a toxicologist.
modes.example: In case of an overdose, consider contacting the Poison Help line (1-800-222-122<<2>>) for additional overdosage management recommendations

card.plain: It marks the end digit of the Poison Help phone number in overdose sections of drug labels.
